svg.text: RD_FDOTA - TWO-INPUT, TWO-OUTPUT, TWO-STAGE OTA WITH CONTINUOUS CMFB
MAIN SIGNAL DEVICES USE SKY130 1.8-V MOS | BOTH COMMON-MODE LOOPS ARE EXPLICITLY IDENTIFIED
OPEN-SOURCE REVIEW VIEW | NOMINAL DYNAMIC PASS | MULTILOOP STABILITY OPEN | NOT CADENCE
N1 -> XRZP 1.2 kohm -> XCCP 8 MIM units -> OUTP
N2 -> XRZN 1.2 kohm -> XCCN 8 MIM units -> OUTN
PHYSICAL PARAMETER AUDIT: 1.2-kohm high-po_0p69 LENGTH 0.855 um >= 0.5 um: PASS
No ideal external IBIAS is used.
BN is about 0.7 V at TT nominal.
STAGE 1 - NMOS DIFFERENTIAL PAIR WITH PMOS CURRENT-SOURCE LOADS
STAGE 2 - MATCHED PMOS GAIN DEVICES AND CMFB-CONTROLLED NMOS SINKS
STAGE-1 DIRECT-SENSE COMMON-MODE LOOP - NCM DRIVES PMOS LOAD GATES
XRN1 / XRN2: N1,N2 to NCM, 100 kohm each
NCM directly drives XMLP / XMLN gates.
OUTPUT CONTINUOUS COMMON-MODE FEEDBACK - CMG DRIVES OUTPUT SINKS
XRCMP / XRCMN: OUTP,OUTN to CMS, 100 kohm each; 1 pF feed-forward each
XCMS / XCMR: CMS vs VCM, W/L = 20/1 um; XCMT W/L = 8/1 um
XRSCS / XRSCR = 10 kohm; XRDS / XRCMG = 105 kohm
CMG drives the 9/1 output sinks; VCM = 0.9 V nominal.
